svg.title: SELECT: share of participants with each cardiovascular event
svg.desc: In-trial cumulative incidence. Primary MACE (CV death, nonfatal MI, or nonfatal stroke): 6.5% on semaglutide 2.4 mg vs 8.0% on placebo. Nonfatal MI 2.7% vs 3.7%. Nonfatal stroke 1.7% vs 1.9%. CV death 2.5% vs 3.0%. All-cause death 4.3% vs 5.2%. Source: Lincoff et al., NEJM 2023, Table 2.
